title: JP Morgan boss Jamie Dimon warns UK chancellor not to hike taxes on banks

paragraphs.en: Jamie Dimon, the boss of the US bank JP Morgan, has urged John Healey not to use his first budget as chancellor to increase taxes on banks’ bumper profits.
paragraphs.zh: 美国银行摩根大通（JP Morgan）的老板杰米·戴蒙（Jamie Dimon）敦促约翰·希利（John Healey）不要利用他作为财政大臣的首次预算案，对银行丰厚的利润加税。

paragraphs.en: Speculation has been growing that a windfall tax could be imposed on UK lenders to fund Andy Burnham’s cost of living agenda, with campaigners estimating such a move could raise £19bn.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的人猜测，可能会对英国贷款机构征收暴利税，以资助安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）的生活成本议程。活动人士估计，此举可筹集190亿英镑。

paragraphs.en: Dimon told Healey in a phone conversation that higher levies could hit jobs, citing a fall in finance roles in New York that he blamed on the city’s tax regime.
paragraphs.zh: 戴蒙在电话交谈中告诉希利，提高税负可能打击就业，并以纽约金融岗位减少为例，称这要归咎于该市的税收制度。

paragraphs.en: Related: Bank battle: history suggests Burnham faces fight if he opts for windfall tax
paragraphs.zh: 相关阅读：银行之争：历史表明，伯纳姆若选择暴利税将面临一场战斗

paragraphs.en: One person familiar with the conversation said the chief executive of the world’s biggest bank’s comments on tax were not specific to the UK, adding that Dimon was the first among many bank bosses to have an introductory call with the new chancellor, with calls with other chief executives to follow.
paragraphs.zh: 一位熟悉此次通话的人士表示，这家全球最大银行首席执行官关于税收的评论并非针对英国，并补充说，戴蒙是众多银行老板中第一个与新任财政大臣进行介绍性通话的人，随后还将与其他首席执行官通话。

paragraphs.en: The Wall Street billionaire’s remarks, first reported by the Financial Times , were condemned by Paul Nowak, the general secretary of the Trades Union Congress (TUC). He said: “People are sick and tired of being told they have to tighten their belts while profits, dividends and bankers’ bonuses hit record highs.
paragraphs.zh: 这位华尔街亿万富翁的言论由英国《金融时报》率先报道，并遭到英国工会联盟（TUC）总书记保罗·诺瓦克（Paul Nowak）的谴责。他说：“人们已经厌倦了被告知必须勒紧腰带，而与此同时，利润、股息和银行家奖金却屡创新高。”

paragraphs.en: “The new chancellor has a clear opportunity to show working people he’s on their side by asking banks to pay fair taxes to cut energy bills.”
paragraphs.zh: “新任财政大臣有一个明确的机会，通过要求银行缴纳公平税款来降低能源账单，向劳动人民表明他与他们站在一起。”

paragraphs.en: Dimon has a long track record of criticising Britain’s additional bank taxes , which were imposed after the government bailed out big UK lenders in the 2008 financial crisis. Lenders in the UK pay a 28% corporation tax rate, higher than the standard 25%, as well as a separate surcharge on their UK balance sheets.
paragraphs.zh: 戴蒙长期以来一直批评英国额外征收的银行税，这些税收是在2008年金融危机期间政府救助大型英国银行之后征收的。英国的银行缴纳28%的公司税税率，高于标准税率25%，此外还要就其英国资产负债表缴纳一项单独的附加税。
